rows.name: for-empty-range
rows.program: for i from 3 to 3 { acc = acc + 1 }

rows.name: for-sum-0-3
rows.program: for i from 0 to 3 { acc = acc + i }

rows.name: for-sum-1-5
rows.program: for i from 1 to 5 { acc = acc + i }

rows.name: for-step-2
rows.program: for i from 0 to 6 step 2 { acc = acc + i }

rows.name: for-negative-step
rows.program: for i from 3 to 0 step -1 { acc = acc + i }

rows.name: for-negative-step-2
rows.program: for i from 6 to 0 step -2 { acc = acc + i }

rows.name: for-single-iteration
rows.program: for i from 0 to 1 { acc = acc + 1 }

rows.name: for-reversed-positive-step
rows.program: for i from 3 to 0 { acc = acc + 1 }

rows.name: for-empty-negative
rows.program: for i from 0 to 3 step -1 { acc = acc + 1 }

rows.name: for-nested-acc
rows.program: for o from 0 to 3 { for n from 0 to 4 { acc = acc + o * n } }

rows.name: for-triple-nested
rows.program: for a from 0 to 2 { for b from 0 to 2 { for c from 0 to 2 { acc = acc + 1 } } }

rows.name: for-counter-product
rows.program: for i from 1 to 5 { acc = acc + i * i }

rows.name: for-helper-in-body
rows.program: for i from 0 to 4 { acc = acc + idp(i) }

rows.name: for-if-in-body
rows.program: for i from 0 to 5 { if i > 2 { acc = acc + i } }

rows.name: for-early-return
rows.program: for i from 0 to 5 { if i == 3 { return i } } / return -1

rows.name: for-bounds-once
rows.program: let n = 3 / for i from 0 to n { n = 0 / acc = acc + 1 }

rows.name: for-big-step
rows.program: for i from 0 to 10 step 100 { acc = acc + i }

rows.name: for-negative-counter
rows.program: for i from -3 to 0 { acc = acc + i }

rows.name: for-step-larger-negative
rows.program: for i from 0 to -6 step -3 { acc = acc + i }

rows.name: for-in-helper-body
rows.program: fn sumto param a integer returns=integer { for i from 0 to a } / return sumto(4)

rows.name: for-let-in-body
rows.program: for i from 0 to 3 { let d = i + 1 / acc = acc + d }

rows.name: for-repeated-counter-name
rows.program: for i from 0 to 3 { acc = acc + i } / for i from 0 to 3 { acc = acc + i }

rows.name: for-step-nonzero-computed
rows.program: for i from 0 to 3 step 0 + 1 { acc = acc + 1 }

rows.name: for-in-if-then
rows.program: if true { for i from 0 to 3 { acc = acc + i } }

rows.name: for-in-if-else
rows.program: if false { for i from 0 to 3 { acc = acc + i } } else { for i from 0 to 5 { acc = acc + i } }
